EC2 콘솔 접속 --- - 해당하는 인스턴스 클릭 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-810d-bffd-db686e061b22/1d4d6ff3fb722084.webp) - 연결 클릭 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-810d-bffd-db686e061b22/eb83c69c6cfba2c1.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-810d-bffd-db686e061b22/12218d4932fafd2b.webp) - 해당 EC2의 콘솔 창으로 접속 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-810d-bffd-db686e061b22/f4708eb9509c87a6.webp)
> ✏️ > > > > 브라우저에서 aws 콘솔로 접속하는 것 보다는, SSH로 터미널에서 접속하는 것이 더 자주 사용되고 편리하다. > > - 강의에서는 해당 내용을 다루지 않으니 추가 자료 조사 후 적용이 필요하다. - 코드 변경 시, push - 이전과 동일 페이지 - compose.yml - Mysql, Redis 설정 정보 추가 ```yaml services: instagram-server: image: 002177417362.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com/instagram-server:latest ports: - 8080:8080 depends_on: my-db: condition: service_healthy my-cache-server: condition: service_healthy my-db: image: mysql environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: pwd1234 MYSQL_DATABASE: mydb volumes: - ./mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql ports: - 3306:3306 healthcheck: test: [ "CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping" ] interval: 5s retries: 10 my-cache-server: image: redis ports: - 6379:6379 healthcheck: test: [ "CMD", "redis-cli", "ping" ] interval: 5s retries: 10 ``` - compose 실행 ```bash # compose 실행 docker compose up -d --build # 실행 확인 docker compose ps # 종료 docker compose down ``` - 확인 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-810d-bffd-db686e061b22/2a86230ad60c8584.webp) - redis ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-810d-bffd-db686e061b22/f9ee8feeaa536862.webp)
